question: What warranty do your lights come with?
answer: Integrated LED fixtures (such as the Peak and Balance pendants) carry a 3-year warranty covering manufacturing defects in the fixture and LED module. Fixtures that use replaceable bulbs (such as the Veer pendant) carry a 2-year warranty; bulbs and glass breakage after delivery are not covered. To make a claim, email support with your order number and photos of the issue.

question: What materials are your products made from?
answer: We work mainly with brass (brushed, polished and antique finishes), powder-coated aluminium, solid oak, opal glass and hand-blown glass. Exact materials and available finishes are listed for each product in the catalogue.

question: Can I customize a light, for example a different finish, size or cable length?
answer: Yes. Most products can be customized with alternative finishes, custom cable or drop lengths, different colour temperatures and, for project orders, bespoke sizes. Custom orders typically add 2-3 weeks to the lead time and may have a minimum order quantity. Contact our projects team with your requirements for a quote.

question: How long does shipping take and where do you deliver?
answer: In-stock items are dispatched within 3-5 business days. Domestic delivery usually takes a further 2-5 business days. We also ship internationally; delivery times and costs depend on the destination and are confirmed at checkout or in your quote. All glass products are shipped in protective packaging.

question: How are the pendant lights installed? Do I need an electrician?
answer: All our fixtures are mains-voltage products and must be installed by a qualified electrician in line with local wiring regulations. Each product ships with a ceiling canopy, mounting bracket and printed installation instructions. Drop length can be adjusted on site.

question: Are your lights dimmable?
answer: Yes. The Peak pendant is dimmable with trailing-edge (TRIAC) dimmers. The Balance pendant supports TRIAC dimming as standard, with DALI or 0-10 V available on request. The Veer pendant is dimmable when used with a dimmable LED bulb.

question: Can your lights be used outdoors or in bathrooms?
answer: Our current pendant range is rated IP20, which means it is suitable for indoor, dry locations only. It should not be installed outdoors, in bathrooms or in other damp areas.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Standard, unused products in their original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Custom or bespoke orders cannot be returned unless faulty. Please contact support to arrange a return.
